findings.name: open_blockers_ignored
findings.observed: The v1 CLI parsed registry.open_blockers but did not use them when computing or accepting a level; the A3 positive fixture inherited an unresolved A1 blocker and still passed.
findings.correction: Package v2 requires structured blockers and caps the computed level below every open blocker’s first_affected_level.

findings.name: boolean_only_observation_promotion
findings.observed: A1–A5 could be reached through plain boolean observations without dated evidence, custody, or scope binding.
findings.correction: Every promotion observation is now a dated evidence receipt with evidence_uri and claim scope fingerprint.

findings.name: incomplete_review_set
findings.observed: The policy required technical review but the v1 CLI checked only legal, privacy, and ethics reviews.
findings.correction: A2+ and real-person use now require four current independent review types: legal, privacy, ethics, and technical.

findings.name: claim_deployment_mode_mismatch
findings.observed: claim.deployment_mode was not checked against deployment.mode or the requested level.
findings.correction: Package v2 requires an exact mode match and a level-specific deployment mode.

findings.name: stale_unsigned_or_cross_scope_receipts
findings.observed: Attestors, authorities, and observations lacked complete date, expiry, independence, and scope checks.
findings.correction: All supporting receipts are current, dated, evidence-linked, and bound to claim.scope_fingerprint.

findings.name: semantic_not_exact_byte_fingerprints
findings.observed: The builder hashed JSON.stringify(parsedDocument), so whitespace and byte-level changes could evade the advertised source fingerprint.
findings.correction: The release manifest now hashes exact UTF-8 bytes, records byte lengths, and computes an ordered combined SHA-256.

findings.name: candidate_landscape_missing_source_locators
findings.observed: The candidate landscape described itself as source-bounded without source IDs, URLs, or explicit support limits.
findings.correction: Every candidate now has official source locators and does-not-support boundaries; the exact Homes for Ukraine candidate is bound to existing repository source records.

findings.name: placeholder_registry_fingerprint
findings.observed: The registry used the literal text generated_by_sprint_05_builder instead of an exact fingerprint.
findings.correction: The source registry now points to the generated exact-byte release manifest; the report resolves and displays the actual combined SHA-256.
